verbatim_quote.english_translation: Better to note it down in a corner (a side note, not inside the task file).

extracted_decision.summary: In-flight findings go to a side note (/tmp) during the run, not into the task file; only final verdicts land in the Execution Log.
extracted_decision.rationale: Manager corrected mid-order: keeps the task file clean while preserving raw findings for the follow-up task.
alternatives: Log everything in the task Execution Log immediately
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Side file is session-local (/tmp) and must be transcribed before it matters.
